status: PLANNED; this plan does not claim new GPU experiments have run
objective: Improve PPU+FlagGems ordinary TF32 performance and cross-input consistency against H100 native TF32, while preserving and separately validating strict FP32.
reporting: Every experiment report includes H100 native FP32/TF32 and PPU+FlagGems FP32/TF32, raw values, input/model/protocol, same-precision errors, source batch, confidence/RMSD, training scope and missing measurements.
constraints: Use original servers, installed environments, unified RNG and complete input/checkpoint audit.
No rules keyed by input identity, model identity or isolated exact shapes; configuration selection may use general dimensions, layout and measured hardware resource constraints.
Do not equate a TF32-enabled flag with actual kernel precision; inspect installed runtime entrypoints.
Same-precision comparison is primary. FP32 drift is separate diagnostic evidence; cross-platform bitwise equality is not required.
Mixed precision is a separate policy and must be applied symmetrically on both platforms for a matched comparison.
Native PPU acBLAS is a diagnostic reference, not a replacement mislabeled as a full FlagGems improvement.
Include allocation, RNE conversion, layout copies and launch overhead in operator timing; label kernel-only measurements separately.

phases.task: Freeze comparable baselines and audit actual TF32 semantics
phases.timing: For each configuration, 3 warmup predictions and 10 measured predictions on an idle device; alternate same-device controls; exclude compilation/preprocessing and profiling from timed predictions.
audit: Exact checkpoints/features/assets/atom ordering and ordered RNG draws
H100 cuEquivariance and PPU Triangle Attention QK/PV precision, rounding, accumulation, scale/mask/bias and probability handling
Native fallback counts, hidden FP32 restoration, installed package versions and override variables
phases.deliverable: Full four-mode baseline tables and a per-operator/per-module precision map; identify whether observed differences arise from semantic mismatch or legitimate numerical differences.

phases.task: Localize the first material divergence using identical real activations
phases.method: Reuse existing capture/replay and module audits; extend the previous FP32-teacher Linear-only probe to TF32 comparisons and QK/PV. Check trunk, Triangle Attention, diffusion conditioning and diffusion outputs. Confirm suspected causes through controlled interventions.
metrics: Relative L2, max absolute error and signed error
Final five confidence metrics and aligned RMSD
Standalone forward/backward/SGD-update errors against the same-precision H100 reference
phases.gate: Use existing 0.1 A RMSD and 5% confidence limits for same-precision end-to-end comparisons. Report training tolerances explicitly; do not invent a PASS threshold. Local operator error alone cannot establish model acceptance.
phases.deliverable: A reproducible failing location and a controlled model-level test that distinguishes an implementation error from propagated floating-point variation.

phases.task: Test a small number of generic TF32 optimizations
phases.first_candidate: Reevaluate TF32 unsplit accumulation with staged prefetch in ordinary-TF32 inference, rather than relying only on the previous mixed-precision runs. Retain the strict FP32 accumulation route.
phases.alternative_if_needed: Reduce simultaneous lifetime of result/partial accumulators and RNE temporaries; restructure loading/prefetch while preserving validated accumulation grouping. Merely increasing stages with the old nested loops has already been rejected.
phases.other_targets: Prioritize MM/addmm/BMM, then Triangle Attention QK/PV and measured layout/launch hotspots. Distinguish matrix compute, RNE conversion, allocation, copies and launch costs. Previously negligible BMM preparation experiments require a new causal mechanism before repetition.
phases.reference: PPU native TF32 GEMM provides a same-input implementation diagnostic; compare total operator cost and clearly label prepared-kernel timings.
phases.gate: Accept only statistically supported whole-model latency improvements under matched precision that survive held-out input/layout/size tests and numerical validation. Do not roll out a local shape gain or a candidate with unresolved model errors.
phases.deliverable: At most two new implementation hypotheses per round, each with source diff, predicted mechanism, measured costs and an explicit keep/reject/pending decision.

phases.task: Expand accepted candidates to nine-model multi-input and full-protocol validation
phases.coverage: All nine models on existing G01/G02 inputs; G03 and short/medium/long held-out inputs as applicable. Move from diagnostic cycle/step/sample settings to the agreed full inference protocol.
phases.validation: Full four-mode timings, five confidence metrics, RMSD, entrypoint/input/RNG audits and standalone training gradient/update checks. Full-model training is a separate measured scope and must not be inferred from operator probes.
phases.MFU: Calculate only after verified executed FLOPs and applicable FP32/TF32 device peaks are established; never substitute a wall-time ratio for MFU.
phases.gate: Publish model/input failures and regressions explicitly. Production adoption requires completed numerical and performance checks; retain the existing FP32 results.

first_round_deliverables: Matched four-mode baselines on G01/G02/G03 with per-configuration warmup/repeat counts
Actual H100-vs-PPU MM/BMM and Triangle Attention QK/PV precision map
Identical-activation TF32 error localization and causal confirmation
Ordinary-TF32 model evaluation of the existing unsplit/stages candidate, with G02 gain attribution

existing_evidence.large_mm_unsplit_stages: Three real activation captures improved approximately 25-40%; this is not a universal model gain.
existing_evidence.existing_unsplit_model_scope: PPU mixed precision only: G01 latency improved about 8.2%; G02 approximately unchanged. H100 matching mixed policy and ordinary-TF32 unsplit model comparison remain unmeasured.
existing_evidence.old_stage_increase: Increasing stages without changing the nested split accumulation slowed two captures; do not blindly repeat.
existing_evidence.precision_localization: Previous 2621 Linear probes used a strict-FP32 teacher and did not cover QK/PV or establish causal coordinate attribution.
